description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 26.02.2018 to 04.03.2013
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs valuations and payments should be calculated. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations.
